fact: The BCC communique states that licensing of banks and financial institutions in the Comoros is its exclusive remit and lists the legally established financial institutions and e-money institutions, including Telco Money SA, Hury Money SA and Comores Assistance Internationale (CASI).
title: Communiqué de la Banque Centrale des Comores sur l'exercice illégal d'activités bancaires offshores
publisher: Ministère des Finances, du Budget et du Secteur Bancaire (reproducing a Banque Centrale des Comores communiqué)
